limits: The manager triage/start/resolve/confirm UI path was not completed in the browser: the cohort serviceReviewer can list the ticket but the detail route redirects to the list. The native PostgreSQL test covers manager triage, owner start/resolve and independent manager confirm-general with persisted receipts/audit/outbox.
The browser journey used a general report. Order-backed create with a customer-note confirmation and typed asset source are PostgreSQL-tested only.
The Support owner remains open: SLA watch, incidents, sessions, capabilities and attachments are separate native workflows.
The Support app logs three React hydration console warnings per navigation; pageErrors stay 0. The warnings are not caused by the native writer and are recorded rather than hidden.
next: Resolve the manager detail-route visibility in the cohort, run the full manager/owner browser lifecycle, then close or formally scope the remaining Support workflows before the scoped PR.
